scripts.test: npm run test --workspaces --if-present && npm run test:backend
scripts._comment:test:backend: Delegates to scripts/run-backend-tests.js, which resolves the venv interpreter in Node (works under both cmd.exe on Windows and sh on Linux/WSL/macOS, unlike a hardcoded shell path). A bare `python` on PATH can resolve to an unrelated environment with no pytest installed, so the interpreter is never left implicit. These root scripts are dev convenience only -- CI runs each workspace directly (see .github/workflows/ci.yml), never this one. See CLAUDE.md > Test Commands.
scripts.docker:test: docker compose -f docker-compose.test.yml run --rm --build backend-tests && docker compose -f docker-compose.test.yml run --rm --build frontend-tests && docker compose -f docker-compose.test.yml run --rm --build mcp-tests
